latestVersion.changelog:
**Changelog for alibabacloud-video-forge v0.0.2**

- Required Aliyun CLI version updated to >= 3.3.3; install/upgrade instructions now included.
- Added mandatory steps to enable and update Aliyun CLI plugins and configure AI-Mode before use.
- Prerequisite section reorganized and clarified for simpler setup.
- Documentation improvements for environment pre-checks and troubleshooting based on user feedback.
- No changes to core feature set or workflow.
